# Caller-aware parser repair — synthetic design fixture

This text is an original contract fixture, not an installed or evaluated skill.

Apply when changing a parser or default that has multiple callers.
Do not apply solely because a task contains the word "parser".

1. Identify direct and indirect callers before changing the shared behavior.
2. Distinguish a missing value from valid zero, false, or empty values.
3. State the intended contract for each caller and patch the smallest shared seam.
4. Verify the affected callers using an independent test oracle.
5. Report untested callers and uncertainty; a successful test is not proof of broader effectiveness.

Required capabilities: complete file reading, caller search, file editing and local test execution.
Do not invent unavailable tools or execute code outside the approved fixture/workspace.
